summary: Third vulnerability rule type: description shown with the finding, without Fix/Undo buttons.
Vulnerability rules: Reboot request checkbox; Quick shows a red Restart required next to the fix.
Vulnerabilities moved to the top of the Quick category list.
Quick vulnerabilities: rule reason and unlabeled Fix/Undo side by side; repaired findings stay listed (muted) so a fix can be undone.
Quick vulnerability Fix/Undo render as buttons in the classic and modern MeshCentral UI.
Quick vulnerabilities: expanded row shows only Fix/Undo with script description (or no-fix note); all Nessus fields move to the details column.
Nessus hosts matched by host name without the domain, never by IP address.
Optional Nessus CSV Repair column and portal-recorded fixes hide repaired findings until a newer scan.
Quick vulnerability Fix/Undo/View buttons opt out of the tree icon grid.
Expandable Quick vulnerability rows with Fix/Undo, scan summary collapsed behind View in Quick and Commands.
Rules table with rollback command, per-row Fix/Undo in Commands, compact Quick table, reboot-required script flag.
Vulnerability exclusions and pinned remediation rules (settings + rules.json), Fix actions, Quick table and My Scripts all-host table with header filters.
Add Nessus CSV import, Commands and Quick vulnerability views, Desktop alert and Site Admin all-host My Script report.
Fix native Quick concurrency through a server-owned resolved execution context marker, preserving ordinary command guard.
Record authenticated MeshCentral requester/confirmer in per-object Jira Assets comments after verified protocol writes.
Allow concurrent native Desktop Quick direct launches on one device while preserving the ordinary per-node agent command guard.
Use the global Entra/AAD integration for Entra ID My Scripts instead of duplicate per-script tenant/client secrets.
Show only the current downloadable CSV report and latest record count in normal Results while preserving full raw diagnostics.
Add server-side single-flight for ordinary My Scripts executions so duplicate active requests reuse one underlying child process.
Single-flight My Scripts browser submissions and download the newest generated CSV without navigating away from MeshCentral.
Load reset users cache-first from Jira and resolve only the selected UPN against AD at execution time.
Use ASCII-safe Polish wording without diacritics for AD account create/reset SMS after repeated real received-message mojibake.
Make bundled My Scripts metadata, dynamic options and execution share one canonical seed source so stale persistent script trees cannot shadow current definitions.
Make Git deployment fail closed unless the real MeshCentral service loads the exact staged MC-SIRK runtime, proven by hashes and a fresh runtime-state marker.
Make development revisions visible to MeshCentral plugin updates and reload MC-SIRK backend dependencies when the on-disk version changes; real smoke later remained unchanged.
Remove the AD reset selector ActiveDirectory module/CLIXML failure path with a bounded UTF-8 DirectoryServices bridge; real smoke later proved the active behavior unchanged.
Bound the AD reset selector to Jira-cache UPN LDAP matches and make Windows PowerShell SMS forms ASCII-safe UTF-8 percent encoded.
Correct the dev.121 AD reset cache credential boundary and preserve Polish SMS text with explicit UTF-8 transport.
Default built-in message workflows to direct execution and make Jira requester confirmations leave the actionable view immediately with User/Assets context.
